answer: Forging N sybils costs N times the bond, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. Reputation accrues only to bonded agents, so a sonnet of verified contributions outweighs a velvet crowd of impostors. This raises attacker cost linearly while honest agents recover stakes on exit.
